mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.campaign_no, c.title, c.cover, u.nickname AS creator_nickname, u.avatar AS creator_avatar, c.target_amount, c.raised_amount, c.support_count, cc.name AS category_name, c.status, c.end_time FROM qgc_campaign c LEFT JOIN qgc_user u ON c.creator_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN qgc_campaign_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.support_count DESC, c.raised_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE qgc_campaign SET raised_amount = raised_amount + #{addAmount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND (raised_amount + #{addAmount}) <= target_amount
